name: Kaelrath Emberhide
title: The Flamekeeper, God-Ascendant of Emberheart
bio: Divine ruler of Emberheart, former smith's apprentice who ascended to godhood. Father of nine, husband to four. Presides over a golden age of kingdom-building with no active wars or divine calamities. Master of Wyrmtooth, Claim-Reborn, and Sunderborne relics.
motivation: Guide Emberheart through an era of prosperity — infrastructure, noble cooperation, and preparing the next generation.
